brief:
Closed military zones in the occupied West Bank have become de facto settler land, Al Jazeera English reported. The restricted areas, officially designated for security purposes, are being used by settlers as staging posts for attacks on Palestinians.

The practice allows settlers to operate in areas nominally under Israeli military control, complicating efforts by Palestinian residents to access their own land and creating new flashpoints for violence across the territory.
dek: Closed military zones in the occupied West Bank are being seized by settlers as staging posts for pogroms.
title: Israeli settlers seize West Bank military zones as staging grounds
